requirements.title: Floating Toolbar Component
requirements.description: Floating toolbar component renders above mobile keyboard with essential terminal keys (Ctrl, Alt, Tab, Esc, arrows). Does not overlap terminal viewport.

validation.notes: Toolbar exports TOOLBAR_KEYS with essential terminal keys

requirements.title: Terminal Key/Chord Mapping
requirements.description: Toolbar keys inject correct escape sequences into active terminal. Chord support (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+D, Ctrl+Z) works reliably.

validation.notes: All chord sequences (Ctrl+C/D/Z) produce correct escape codes
Arrow keys and special keys send correct ANSI sequences

requirements.title: Chord Sequence Reliability
requirements.description: Chord sequences (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+D, Ctrl+Z) reliably produce correct escape codes under rapid input and concurrent terminal sessions.

validation.notes: All chord sequences produce correct escape codes
